upstream: https://github.com/higan-emu/libco
files: libco.c + libco.h (initial fetch 2026-04-25)
       amd64.c + fiber.c + settings.h + valgrind.h (added 2026-04-25 via `gh api`)
notes: single-file cooperative-fiber lib; vendored verbatim. amd64.c is the
       per-arch implementation libco.c #includes for x86_64 Linux/macOS;
       fiber.c is the Windows fallback used by the MinGW cross-build path.
       settings.h is the build-config sibling both arch sources need. No
       local patches.

2026-11-26 additions for the iOS port (ios-port branch):
  aarch64.c       - verbatim from higan-emu/libco (e18e09d, ISC), for non-Apple arm64.
  aarch64_apple.c - ours, derived from aarch64.c. Same 25-instruction swap routine
                    assembled into the text section instead of a data array +
                    mprotect(PROT_EXEC), which iOS forbids without the JIT entitlement.
                    Instruction words verified identical to aarch64.c's table.
  libco.c         - dispatches __aarch64__ && __APPLE__ to aarch64_apple.c.
  (libco.c also carries earlier local patches: Win32 fiber.c and Emscripten selection.)
